phase_prompt.summary: 'Iylumi'el stands at his post within the gate band, monitoring the seasonal transitions with stoic precision. He is a weary operator of the celestial machine, bathed in the contrasting light of the deep system dark and the blinding solar ingress.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic close-up of 'Iylumi'el's face, skin texture like porous black stone, eyes reflecting the scrolling data of the simulation's star chart. He looks down at a glass slate in his hands, illuminated by the warm amber glow of vector graphics. The environment is the cramped, utilitarian interior of a star-gate control room, with obsidian walls and bundles of fiber-optic cabling. The lighting is moody, chiaroscuro, emphasizing the solitude of his task. 8k, cinematic realism, highly detailed.
